sources.title: Tritax Big Box REIT plc: Half-year Report for the six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS, 5 August 2026)
sources.publisher: Tritax Big Box REIT plc (RNS regulatory announcement, as published by Investegate)
sources.attribution: Tritax Big Box REIT plc via RNS / Investegate
sources.summary: Tritax Big Box's half-year report, released as an RNS announcement on 5 August 2026. Under 'Planning consent secured at Manor Farm' it says that in January 2025 the company bought the 74-acre Manor Farm site at Heathrow, within the Slough Availability Zone, and formed a 50:50 joint venture with EDF Renewables to deliver power from existing grid connection agreements: 107 MW in 2027 and a further 40 MW in 2029, supported by on-site battery storage. It says that on 10 June 2026 the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government approved the proposal, 'which will enable us to begin site preparation works in the second half of the year', and that a pre-let with a potential occupier on a powered-shell basis is in solicitors' hands. The highlights list 'Planning consent secured for Manor Farm' and the '107MW Phase 1 Manor Farm pre-let'. Practical completion is expected in Q2 2028; data-centre capital expenditure in the half was GBP 1.6 million. It also names a second scheme at Chelmsford (125 MW of power, delivery expected 2029; formal marketing from July).
sources.date_semantics: Published 5 August 2026 (dated 5 August 2026 in the announcement; Investegate lists it at 16:36 that day). It is the company's own dated statement that the Manor Farm scheme is consented and not yet under construction. Q2 2028 completion, 2027/2029 power and H2 2026 site preparation are forecasts.

sources.title: Tritax Big Box REIT plc: Planning consent secured for 107MW Manor Farm data centre (RNS, 27 July 2026)
sources.publisher: Tritax Big Box REIT plc (RNS regulatory announcement, as published by Investegate)
sources.attribution: Tritax Big Box REIT plc via RNS / Investegate
sources.summary: RNS of 27 July 2026: the six-week judicial review period for the Manor Farm data centre development 'has concluded successfully', so the company can now progress a 107 MW facility on its 74-acre site in the Slough Availability Zone; a pre-let agreement is in solicitors' hands and the facility targets a 9.3% yield on cost.
sources.date_semantics: Published 27 July 2026, two days before this fragment's 85-day window, so it is identity and consent context only (it confirms no statutory challenge was brought against the 10 June decision).

sources.publisher: Tritax Big Box REIT plc (RNS regulatory announcement, as published by Investegate)
sources.attribution: Tritax Big Box REIT plc via RNS / Investegate
sources.summary: RNS of 10 June 2026 confirming that the Secretary of State approved the company's proposed data centre at Manor Farm, Heathrow, and linking the GOV.UK publication 'Recovered appeal: land at Manor Farm and land north of Wraysbury Reservoir, Poyle Road, Slough (ref 3366043)'. This links the Tritax scheme to the appeal and its planning application.
sources.date_semantics: Published 10 June 2026; identity bridge only (outside the window).

sources.title: MHCLG decision letter and Inspector's Report: recovered appeal APP/J0350/W/25/3366043, land at Manor Farm and land north of Wraysbury Reservoir, Poyle Road, Slough (10 June 2026)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (Planning Casework Unit) and the Planning Inspectorate
sources.attribution: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government; Planning Inspectorate
sources.summary: Decision letter of 10 June 2026 (186-page combined PDF with the Inspector's Report). On behalf of the Secretary of State the appeal by Manor Farm Propco Limited against Slough Borough Council's non-determination is allowed and planning permission granted, subject to the conditions in Annex B, for demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment to comprise a data centre (Use Class B8) and battery energy storage system with ancillary substation, offices, plant, emergency backup generators and fuel storage, landscaping, drainage, parking and access from Poyle Road, under application P/10076/013 dated 13 December 2024. Condition 1 requires commencement within three years. The Inspector's Report describes an 8.16 ha site west of Poyle Road with a northern Area A for the data centre (about 36,368 sq m GIA, 23 m parapet) and a southern Area B for a 100 MW battery storage system. Any High Court challenge had to be made within six weeks of the letter.
sources.date_semantics: Decision dated and published 10 June 2026, 134 days before this review and outside the 85-day window: it is consent context, not the admission status.
